Aisha: Heads-up — I'm seeing a cancellation leak in the Go SDK generator streaming path when an auth token refresh happens mid-stream. Repro in a tiny sample app I put together.
Diego: Can you paste the minimal repro / snippet?
Aisha: Yep — gist below. Essentially: create a ctx with cancel, call GenerateStream(ctx,...), then trigger auth refresh from the refresh goroutine. The stream keeps emitting until the token refresh finishes instead of stopping on ctx cancel.
Aisha: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
defer cancel()
s := client.GenerateStream(ctx, req)
// ... in background tokenRefresher() we rotate creds which triggers SDK retry/refresh path
// I call cancel() right after opening the stream and the routine still emits tokens for ~2s
for s.Next() {
    fmt.Println(s.Token())
}
```
Yvonne: I've hit a similar one with the retry middleware — sometimes the refresh spawns a goroutine that holds the transport open.
Sam: Is this specific to oauth refresh or also seen with API key rotation / Dedicated?
Aisha: Reproduced on hosted oauth refresh and once against Dedicated when we rotated a short-lived key via our secrets operator.
Diego: Can you drop the tiny repro repo? I'll run it.
Aisha: https://github.com/redwood/repro-go-stream-cancel (small README + failing test).
Sam: Quick workaround: after cancel call stream.CloseSend() / Close() in a goroutine so you don't block, but that's ugly. Ideally SDK should propagate ctx cancel to the transport and cancel in-flights even if auth refresh is in progress. :eyes:
Yvonne: Agreed. Sounds like we need to ensure token refresh doesn't keep the stream goroutine pinned — either surface a cancel channel into the refresher or make refresh synchronous and cancellable.
Diego: Filed an issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123 with repro and logs.
Aisha: Added logs and a short heap/goroutine dump to the ticket. Please assign to eng-runtime.
ci-bot: Uploaded failing-test snapshot to artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/1768888888/stream-cancel-snapshot.log
Sam: I'll take a look after standup and propose a minimal fix path (probably alter transport refresh path to watch ctx).
Yvonne: If you need a design sync ping me, happy to sketch out the cancellation tokens and where to thread them.
Diego: Thx — triaging now.
Aisha: Thanks all, really appreciate the quick responses.
